CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.articles_search_vector_update()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  NEW.search_vector :=
    setweight(to_tsvector('pg_catalog.english'::regconfig, coalesce(NEW.title, '')), 'A') ||
    setweight(to_tsvector('pg_catalog.simple'::regconfig,  coalesce(array_to_string(NEW.labels, ' '), '')), 'B') ||
    setweight(to_tsvector('pg_catalog.english'::regconfig, coalesce(NEW.clinical_bottom_line, '')), 'B') ||
    setweight(to_tsvector('pg_catalog.english'::regconfig, coalesce(NEW.summary, '')), 'C');
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_table_grants()
 RETURNS TABLE(table_name text, missing_roles text[])
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  WITH app_tables(tname) AS (
    VALUES
      ('analytics_daily_snapshot'),
      ('analytics_insight_feedback'),
      ('analytics_insights'),
      ('analytics_opportunities'),
      ('analytics_signals'),
      ('articles'),
      ('articles_blacklist'),

      ('growth_agent_memory'),
      ('growth_agent_preferences'),
      ('growth_tasks'),
      ('page_views'),
      ('reports'),
      ('saved_articles'),
      ('search_logs'),
      ('security_reports'),
      ('sync_skipped_articles'),
      ('synthesis_feedback'),
      ('user_consents'),
      ('user_preferences'),
      ('user_roles')
  ),
  granted AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT g.table_name
    FROM information_schema.role_table_grants g
    WHERE g.table_schema = 'public'
      AND g.grantee = 'authenticated'
  )
  SELECT a.tname AS table_name,
         ARRAY['authenticated'] AS missing_roles
  FROM app_tables a
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM granted g WHERE g.table_name = a.tname
  )
  ORDER BY a.tname;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.harness_acl_report()
 RETURNS TABLE(object text, kind text, grantee text, privileges text[])
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  WITH rels AS (
    SELECT c.oid, c.relname, c.relkind, c.relowner, c.relacl
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c
    JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
    WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
      AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'p', 'v', 'm', 'S', 'f')
  ),
  grantees(name) AS (
    VALUES ('anon'), ('authenticated'), ('service_role'), ('PUBLIC')
  ),
  named AS (
    SELECT r.oid,
           CASE WHEN a.grantee = 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE ro.rolname::text END AS grantee,
           a.privilege_type
    FROM rels r
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.aclexplode(
      coalesce(r.relacl,
               pg_catalog.acldefault(
                 (CASE WHEN r.relkind = 'S' THEN 's' ELSE 'r' END)::pg_catalog."char",
                 r.relowner))) AS a
    LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_roles ro ON ro.oid = a.grantee
  )
  SELECT 'public.' || r.relname,
         CASE r.relkind
           WHEN 'r' THEN 'table'
           WHEN 'p' THEN 'partitioned table'
           WHEN 'v' THEN 'view'
           WHEN 'm' THEN 'materialized view'
           WHEN 'S' THEN 'sequence'
           WHEN 'f' THEN 'foreign table'
         END,
         g.name,
         coalesce(
           array_agg(DISTINCT nm.privilege_type ORDER BY nm.privilege_type)
             FILTER (WHERE nm.privilege_type IS NOT NULL),
           '{}'::text[])
  FROM rels r
  CROSS JOIN grantees g
  LEFT JOIN named nm ON nm.oid = r.oid AND nm.grantee = g.name
  GROUP BY r.oid, r.relname, r.relkind, g.name

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 'defaults ' || CASE WHEN d.defaclnamespace = 0 THEN 'global' ELSE dn.nspname::text END
           || ' by ' || pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(d.defaclrole),
         CASE d.defaclobjtype WHEN 'r' THEN 'default:tables' WHEN 'S' THEN 'default:sequences' END,
         CASE WHEN a.grantee = 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE coalesce(ro.rolname::text, a.grantee::text) END,
         array_agg(DISTINCT a.privilege_type ORDER BY a.privilege_type)
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_default_acl d
  LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace dn ON dn.oid = d.defaclnamespace
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.aclexplode(d.defaclacl) AS a
  LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_roles ro ON ro.oid = a.grantee
  WHERE d.defaclobjtype IN ('r', 'S')
    AND (d.defaclnamespace = 0 OR dn.nspname = 'public')
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.harness_rls_report()
 RETURNS TABLE(object text, kind text, rls_on boolean, rls_forced boolean, policy text, command text, roles text[], permissive boolean, using_expr text, check_expr text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  WITH rels AS (
    SELECT c.oid, c.relname, c.relrowsecurity, c.relforcerowsecurity
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c
    JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
    WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
      AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'p')
  )
  SELECT 'public.' || r.relname, 'table', r.relrowsecurity, r.relforcerowsecurity,
         NULL::text, NULL::text, NULL::text[], NULL::boolean, NULL::text, NULL::text
  FROM rels r

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 'public.' || r.relname, 'policy', NULL::boolean, NULL::boolean,
         p.polname::text,
         CASE p.polcmd WHEN 'r' THEN 'SELECT' WHEN 'a' THEN 'INSERT' WHEN 'w' THEN 'UPDATE'
                       WHEN 'd' THEN 'DELETE' WHEN '*' THEN 'ALL' END,
         CASE WHEN p.polroles = '{0}'::pg_catalog.oid[] THEN ARRAY['PUBLIC']::text[]
              ELSE ARRAY(SELECT ro.rolname::text FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles ro
                         WHERE ro.oid = ANY (p.polroles) ORDER BY 1) END,
         p.polpermissive,
         pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(p.polqual, p.polrelid),
         pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(p.polwithcheck, p.polrelid)
  FROM rels r
  JOIN pg_catalog.pg_policy p ON p.polrelid = r.oid;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.harness_schema_report()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
WITH
pub AS (SELECT oid FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace WHERE nspname = 'public'),
-- every object that belongs to an extension (covered by the extensions section)
ext_member AS (
  SELECT d.classid, d.objid FROM pg_catalog.pg_depend d WHERE d.deptype = 'e'
),
-- relations owned by an extension, with what PostgreSQL creates for them: a relation that is an extension member,
-- the relation backing an extension-owned composite type, and an index on an extension-owned relation
ext_cls AS (
  SELECT c.oid FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c
  WHERE c.relnamespace = (SELECT oid FROM pub)
    AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ext_member e WHERE e.classid = 'pg_catalog.pg_class'::pg_catalog.regclass AND e.objid = c.oid)
         OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ext_member e WHERE e.classid = 'pg_catalog.pg_type'::pg_catalog.regclass AND e.objid = c.reltype)
         OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_index i JOIN ext_member e
                      ON e.classid = 'pg_catalog.pg_class'::pg_catalog.regclass AND e.objid = i.indrelid
                    WHERE i.indexrelid = c.oid))
),
-- types owned by an extension: members, the row types of its relations, and the array types of its types
ext_typ AS (
  SELECT t.oid FROM pg_catalog.pg_type t
  WHERE t.typnamespace = (SELECT oid FROM pub)
    AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ext_member e WHERE e.classid = 'pg_catalog.pg_type'::pg_catalog.regclass AND e.objid = t.oid)
         OR t.typrelid IN (SELECT oid FROM ext_cls)
         OR (t.typcategory = 'A' AND t.typelem <> 0
             AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ext_member e WHERE e.classid = 'pg_catalog.pg_type'::pg_catalog.regclass AND e.objid = t.typelem)))
),
rel AS (
  SELECT c.* FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c
  WHERE c.relnamespace = (SELECT oid FROM pub)
    AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'p', 'v', 'm', 'S', 'f')
    AND c.oid NOT IN (SELECT oid FROM ext_cls)
),
fn AS (
  SELECT p.* FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p
  WHERE p.pronamespace = (SELECT oid FROM pub)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ext_member e WHERE e.classid = 'pg_catalog.pg_proc'::pg_catalog.regclass AND e.objid = p.oid)
),
typ AS (
  SELECT t.* FROM pg_catalog.pg_type t
  WHERE t.typnamespace = (SELECT oid FROM pub)
    AND t.oid NOT IN (SELECT oid FROM ext_typ)
),
-- type classification: covered kinds, generated dependents, and the rest (unsupported)
typ_class AS (
  SELECT t.oid, t.typname,
    CASE
      WHEN t.typtype = 'e' THEN 'enum'
      WHEN t.typtype = 'd' THEN 'domain'
      WHEN t.typtype = 'c' AND tr.relkind = 'c' THEN 'composite'
      WHEN t.typtype = 'c' AND tr.oid IS NOT NULL
           AND (tr.oid IN (SELECT oid FROM rel)) THEN 'generated'
      WHEN t.typcategory = 'A' AND t.typelem <> 0
           AND (te.typnamespace <> (SELECT oid FROM pub)
                OR te.typtype IN ('e', 'd')
                OR (te.typtype = 'c' AND (ter.relkind = 'c' OR ter.oid IN (SELECT oid FROM rel)))
                OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ext_member e WHERE e.classid = 'pg_catalog.pg_type'::pg_catalog.regclass AND e.objid = te.oid))
           THEN 'generated'
      ELSE 'unsupported'
    END AS class
  FROM typ t
  LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class tr ON tr.oid = t.typrelid
  LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_type te ON te.oid = t.typelem
  LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class ter ON ter.oid = te.typrelid
),
unsupported AS (
  -- relations of other kinds (indexes count only when they index a covered relation; composite relations
  -- are their types' business)
  SELECT 'relation:' || c.relkind::text AS kind, c.relname::text AS name
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c
  WHERE c.relnamespace = (SELECT oid FROM pub)
    AND c.relkind NOT IN ('r', 'p', 'v', 'm', 'S', 'f', 'c')
    AND c.oid NOT IN (SELECT oid FROM ext_cls)
    AND NOT (c.relkind IN ('i', 'I') AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_index i WHERE i.indexrelid = c.oid AND i.indrelid IN (SELECT oid FROM rel)))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'type:' || t.typtype::text, t.typname::text FROM typ t JOIN typ_class k ON k.oid = t.oid WHERE k.class = 'unsupported'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'routine:' || p.prokind::text, p.proname::text FROM fn p WHERE p.prokind NOT IN ('f', 'p')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'rule', r.rulename::text FROM pg_catalog.pg_rewrite r JOIN rel c ON c.oid = r.ev_class
  WHERE NOT (r.rulename = '_RETURN' AND c.relkind IN ('v', 'm'))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'operator', o.oprname::text FROM pg_catalog.pg_operator o
  WHERE o.oprnamespace = (SELECT oid FROM pub)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ext_member e WHERE e.classid = 'pg_catalog.pg_operator'::pg_catalog.regclass AND e.objid = o.oid)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'operator class', oc.opcname::text FROM pg_catalog.pg_opclass oc
  WHERE oc.opcnamespace = (SELECT oid FROM pub)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ext_member e WHERE e.classid = 'pg_catalog.pg_opclass'::pg_catalog.regclass AND e.objid = oc.oid)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'operator family', ofa.opfname::text FROM pg_catalog.pg_opfamily ofa
  WHERE ofa.opfnamespace = (SELECT oid FROM pub)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ext_member e WHERE e.classid = 'pg_catalog.pg_opfamily'::pg_catalog.regclass AND e.objid = ofa.oid)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'collation', co.collname::text FROM pg_catalog.pg_collation co
  WHERE co.collnamespace = (SELECT oid FROM pub)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ext_member e WHERE e.classid = 'pg_catalog.pg_collation'::pg_catalog.regclass AND e.objid = co.oid)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'conversion', cv.conname::text FROM pg_catalog.pg_conversion cv
  WHERE cv.connamespace = (SELECT oid FROM pub)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ext_member e WHERE e.classid = 'pg_catalog.pg_conversion'::pg_catalog.regclass AND e.objid = cv.oid)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'text search configuration', x.cfgname::text FROM pg_catalog.pg_ts_config x
  WHERE x.cfgnamespace = (SELECT oid FROM pub)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ext_member e WHERE e.classid = 'pg_catalog.pg_ts_config'::pg_catalog.regclass AND e.objid = x.oid)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'text search dictionary', x.dictname::text FROM pg_catalog.pg_ts_dict x
  WHERE x.dictnamespace = (SELECT oid FROM pub)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ext_member e WHERE e.classid = 'pg_catalog.pg_ts_dict'::pg_catalog.regclass AND e.objid = x.oid)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'text search parser', x.prsname::text FROM pg_catalog.pg_ts_parser x
  WHERE x.prsnamespace = (SELECT oid FROM pub)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ext_member e WHERE e.classid = 'pg_catalog.pg_ts_parser'::pg_catalog.regclass AND e.objid = x.oid)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'text search template', x.tmplname::text FROM pg_catalog.pg_ts_template x
  WHERE x.tmplnamespace = (SELECT oid FROM pub)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ext_member e WHERE e.classid = 'pg_catalog.pg_ts_template'::pg_catalog.regclass AND e.objid = x.oid)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'statistics object', s.stxname::text FROM pg_catalog.pg_statistic_ext s
  WHERE s.stxnamespace = (SELECT oid FROM pub)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'cast', pg_catalog.format_type(ca.castsource, NULL) || ' -> ' || pg_catalog.format_type(ca.casttarget, NULL)
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_cast ca
  WHERE (ca.castsource IN (SELECT oid FROM typ) OR ca.casttarget IN (SELECT oid FROM typ)
         OR ca.castfunc IN (SELECT oid FROM fn))
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ext_member e WHERE e.classid = 'pg_catalog.pg_cast'::pg_catalog.regclass AND e.objid = ca.oid)
)
SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
  'format', 1,
  'server_version_num', pg_catalog.current_setting('server_version_num')::int,

  'relations', COALESCE((
    SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'name', 'public.' || c.relname,
      'kind', CASE c.relkind WHEN 'r' THEN 'table' WHEN 'p' THEN 'partitioned table' WHEN 'v' THEN 'view'
                             WHEN 'm' THEN 'materialized view' WHEN 'S' THEN 'sequence' WHEN 'f' THEN 'foreign table' END,
      'owner', pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner)::text,
      'acl', COALESCE((
        SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('grantee', g.grantee, 'privilege', g.privilege, 'grantable', g.grantable)
               ORDER BY g.grantee, g.privilege)
        FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN a.grantee = 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee)::text END AS grantee,
                     a.privilege_type AS privilege, pg_catalog.bool_or(a.is_grantable) AS grantable
              FROM pg_catalog.aclexplode(COALESCE(c.relacl, pg_catalog.acldefault(CASE WHEN c.relkind = 'S' THEN 's' ELSE 'r' END::"char", c.relowner))) a GROUP BY 1, 2) g
      ), '[]'::jsonb),
      'rls', c.relrowsecurity,
      'rls_forced', c.relforcerowsecurity,
      'options', COALESCE(pg_catalog.to_jsonb(c.reloptions), '[]'::jsonb),
      'columns', COALESCE((
        SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
                 'name', att.attname::text,
                 'type', pg_catalog.format_type(att.atttypid, att.atttypmod),
                 'collation', CASE WHEN att.attcollation = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (
                   SELECT pg_catalog.quote_ident(cn.nspname) || '.' || pg_catalog.quote_ident(co.collname) FROM pg_catalog.pg_collation co
                   JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace cn ON cn.oid = co.collnamespace WHERE co.oid = att.attcollation) END,
                 'not_null', att.attnotnull,
                 'default', (SELECT pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(ad.adbin, ad.adrelid) FROM pg_catalog.pg_attrdef ad
                             WHERE ad.adrelid = att.attrelid AND ad.adnum = att.attnum),
                 'identity', NULLIF(att.attidentity::text, ''),
                 'generated', NULLIF(att.attgenerated::text, ''),
                 'acl', COALESCE((
                   SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('grantee', g.grantee, 'privilege', g.privilege, 'grantable', g.grantable)
                          ORDER BY g.grantee, g.privilege)
                   FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN a.grantee = 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee)::text END AS grantee,
                                a.privilege_type AS privilege, pg_catalog.bool_or(a.is_grantable) AS grantable
                         FROM pg_catalog.aclexplode(att.attacl) a GROUP BY 1, 2) g
                 ), '[]'::jsonb))
               ORDER BY att.attnum)
        FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute att
        WHERE att.attrelid = c.oid AND att.attnum > 0 AND NOT att.attisdropped
      ), '[]'::jsonb),
      'constraints', COALESCE((
        SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
                 'name', con.conname::text, 'type', con.contype::text,
                 'definition', pg_catalog.pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid),
                 'deferrable', con.condeferrable, 'deferred', con.condeferred, 'validated', con.convalidated)
               ORDER BY con.conname)
        FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint con WHERE con.conrelid = c.oid
      ), '[]'::jsonb),
      'indexes', COALESCE((
        SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
                 'name', ic.relname::text,
                 'definition', pg_catalog.pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid),
                 'valid', i.indisvalid, 'ready', i.indisready,
                 'constraint', (SELECT con.conname::text FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint con
                                WHERE con.conindid = i.indexrelid AND con.conrelid = c.oid AND con.contype IN ('p', 'u', 'x')))
               ORDER BY ic.relname)
        FROM pg_catalog.pg_index i JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class ic ON ic.oid = i.indexrelid
        WHERE i.indrelid = c.oid
      ), '[]'::jsonb),
      'triggers', COALESCE((
        SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
                 'name', tg.tgname::text, 'definition', pg_catalog.pg_get_triggerdef(tg.oid), 'enabled', tg.tgenabled::text)
               ORDER BY tg.tgname)
        FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger tg WHERE tg.tgrelid = c.oid AND NOT tg.tgisinternal
      ), '[]'::jsonb),
      'view_definition', CASE WHEN c.relkind IN ('v', 'm') THEN pg_catalog.pg_get_viewdef(c.oid) END,
      'sequence', CASE WHEN c.relkind = 'S' THEN (
        SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
                 'type', pg_catalog.format_type(s.seqtypid, NULL),
                 'start', s.seqstart::text, 'increment', s.seqincrement::text,
                 'min', s.seqmin::text, 'max', s.seqmax::text, 'cache', s.seqcache::text, 'cycle', s.seqcycle,
                 'owned_by', (SELECT 'public.' || pg_catalog.quote_ident(oc.relname) || '.' || pg_catalog.quote_ident(oa.attname) || ' (' || d.deptype::text || ')'
                              FROM pg_catalog.pg_depend d
                              JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class oc ON oc.oid = d.refobjid
                              JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute oa ON oa.attrelid = d.refobjid AND oa.attnum = d.refobjsubid
                              WHERE d.classid = 'pg_catalog.pg_class'::pg_catalog.regclass AND d.objid = c.oid
                                AND d.refclassid = 'pg_catalog.pg_class'::pg_catalog.regclass AND d.deptype IN ('a', 'i')
                              LIMIT 1))
        FROM pg_catalog.pg_sequence s WHERE s.seqrelid = c.oid) END)
      ORDER BY c.relname)
    FROM rel c
  ), '[]'::jsonb),

  'routines', COALESCE((
    SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'signature', p.oid::pg_catalog.regprocedure::text,
      'kind', p.prokind::text,
      'language', (SELECT l.lanname::text FROM pg_catalog.pg_language l WHERE l.oid = p.prolang),
      'owner', pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner)::text,
      'security_definer', p.prosecdef,
      'volatility', p.provolatile::text,
      'config', COALESCE(pg_catalog.to_jsonb(p.proconfig), '[]'::jsonb),
      'definition', pg_catalog.pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),
      'acl', COALESCE((
        SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('grantee', g.grantee, 'privilege', g.privilege, 'grantable', g.grantable)
               ORDER BY g.grantee, g.privilege)
        FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN a.grantee = 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee)::text END AS grantee,
                     a.privilege_type AS privilege, pg_catalog.bool_or(a.is_grantable) AS grantable
              FROM pg_catalog.aclexplode(COALESCE(p.proacl, pg_catalog.acldefault('f'::"char", p.proowner))) a GROUP BY 1, 2) g
      ), '[]'::jsonb))
      ORDER BY p.oid::pg_catalog.regprocedure::text)
    FROM fn p WHERE p.prokind IN ('f', 'p')
  ), '[]'::jsonb),

  'types', COALESCE((
    SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'name', 'public.' || t.typname,
      'kind', k.class,
      'owner', pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(t.typowner)::text,
      'acl', COALESCE((
        SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('grantee', g.grantee, 'privilege', g.privilege, 'grantable', g.grantable)
               ORDER BY g.grantee, g.privilege)
        FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN a.grantee = 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee)::text END AS grantee,
                     a.privilege_type AS privilege, pg_catalog.bool_or(a.is_grantable) AS grantable
              FROM pg_catalog.aclexplode(COALESCE(t.typacl, pg_catalog.acldefault('T'::"char", t.typowner))) a GROUP BY 1, 2) g
      ), '[]'::jsonb),
      'labels', CASE WHEN k.class = 'enum' THEN COALESCE((
        SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(en.enumlabel::text ORDER BY en.enumsortorder)
        FROM pg_catalog.pg_enum en WHERE en.enumtypid = t.oid), '[]'::jsonb) END,
      'base_type', CASE WHEN k.class = 'domain' THEN pg_catalog.format_type(t.typbasetype, t.typtypmod) END,
      'not_null', CASE WHEN k.class = 'domain' THEN t.typnotnull END,
      'default', CASE WHEN k.class = 'domain' THEN pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(t.typdefaultbin, 0) END,
      'constraints', CASE WHEN k.class = 'domain' THEN COALESCE((
        SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
                 'name', con.conname::text, 'definition', pg_catalog.pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid), 'validated', con.convalidated)
               ORDER BY con.conname)
        FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint con WHERE con.contypid = t.oid), '[]'::jsonb) END,
      'attributes', CASE WHEN k.class = 'composite' THEN COALESCE((
        SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
                 'name', att.attname::text, 'type', pg_catalog.format_type(att.atttypid, att.atttypmod))
               ORDER BY att.attnum)
        FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute att
        WHERE att.attrelid = t.typrelid AND att.attnum > 0 AND NOT att.attisdropped), '[]'::jsonb) END)
      ORDER BY t.typname)
    FROM typ t JOIN typ_class k ON k.oid = t.oid
    WHERE k.class IN ('enum', 'domain', 'composite')
  ), '[]'::jsonb),

  'schema', (
    SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'owner', pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(n.nspowner)::text,
      'acl', COALESCE((
        SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('grantee', g.grantee, 'privilege', g.privilege, 'grantable', g.grantable)
               ORDER BY g.grantee, g.privilege)
        FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN a.grantee = 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee)::text END AS grantee,
                     a.privilege_type AS privilege, pg_catalog.bool_or(a.is_grantable) AS grantable
              FROM pg_catalog.aclexplode(COALESCE(n.nspacl, pg_catalog.acldefault('n'::"char", n.nspowner))) a GROUP BY 1, 2) g
      ), '[]'::jsonb))
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace n WHERE n.nspname = 'public'),

  'extensions', COALESCE((
    SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'name', x.extname::text, 'version', x.extversion,
      'schema', (SELECT n.nspname::text FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace n WHERE n.oid = x.extnamespace))
      ORDER BY x.extname)
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_extension x
  ), '[]'::jsonb),

  'default_acls', COALESCE((
    SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'role', pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(da.defaclrole)::text,
      'schema', (SELECT n.nspname::text FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace n WHERE n.oid = da.defaclnamespace),
      'object_type', da.defaclobjtype::text,
      'acl', COALESCE((
        SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('grantee', g.grantee, 'privilege', g.privilege, 'grantable', g.grantable)
               ORDER BY g.grantee, g.privilege)
        FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN a.grantee = 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee)::text END AS grantee,
                     a.privilege_type AS privilege, pg_catalog.bool_or(a.is_grantable) AS grantable
              FROM pg_catalog.aclexplode(da.defaclacl) a GROUP BY 1, 2) g
      ), '[]'::jsonb))
      ORDER BY pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(da.defaclrole), da.defaclnamespace, da.defaclobjtype)
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_default_acl da
  ), '[]'::jsonb),

  'roles', COALESCE((
    SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'name', r.rolname::text, 'superuser', r.rolsuper, 'inherit', r.rolinherit, 'create_role', r.rolcreaterole,
      'create_db', r.rolcreatedb, 'login', r.rolcanlogin, 'replication', r.rolreplication, 'bypass_rls', r.rolbypassrls,
      -- one entry per granted role (grants by several grantors merged), with the options that decide what the
      -- membership allows: ADMIN (grant it on), INHERIT (use its privileges), SET (SET ROLE to it)
      'member_of', COALESCE((
        SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('role', mm.role, 'admin', mm.admin, 'inherit', mm.inherit, 'set', mm.set)
                                    ORDER BY mm.role)
        FROM (SELECT g.rolname::text AS role, pg_catalog.bool_or(m.admin_option) AS admin,
                     pg_catalog.bool_or(m.inherit_option) AS inherit, pg_catalog.bool_or(m.set_option) AS set
              FROM pg_catalog.pg_auth_members m JOIN pg_catalog.pg_roles g ON g.oid = m.roleid
              WHERE m.member = r.oid GROUP BY g.rolname) mm), '[]'::jsonb))
      ORDER BY r.rolname)
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles r
    WHERE r.rolname IN ('anon', 'authenticated', 'service_role', 'authenticator', 'postgres')
  ), '[]'::jsonb),

  'event_triggers', COALESCE((
    SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'name', et.evtname::text, 'event', et.evtevent::text, 'enabled', et.evtenabled::text,
      'function', et.evtfoid::pg_catalog.regprocedure::text,
      'tags', COALESCE(pg_catalog.to_jsonb(et.evttags), '[]'::jsonb))
      ORDER BY et.evtname)
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_event_trigger et
  ), '[]'::jsonb),

  'publications', COALESCE((
    SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'name', pb.pubname::text, 'owner', pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(pb.pubowner)::text, 'all_tables', pb.puballtables,
      'insert', pb.pubinsert, 'update', pb.pubupdate, 'delete', pb.pubdelete, 'truncate', pb.pubtruncate,
      'via_root', pb.pubviaroot,
      'schemas', COALESCE((
        SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(n.nspname::text ORDER BY n.nspname)
        FROM pg_catalog.pg_publication_namespace pn JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = pn.pnnspid
        WHERE pn.pnpubid = pb.oid), '[]'::jsonb),
      -- every table in the publication, any schema, with its row filter and column list (NULL = all columns)
      'tables', COALESCE((
        SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
                 'name', pg_catalog.quote_ident(pn.nspname) || '.' || pg_catalog.quote_ident(pc.relname),
                 'row_filter', pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(pr.prqual, pr.prrelid),
                 'columns', CASE WHEN pr.prattrs IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (
                   SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(att.attname::text ORDER BY att.attnum) FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute att
                   WHERE att.attrelid = pr.prrelid AND att.attnum = ANY (pr.prattrs::pg_catalog.int2[])) END)
               ORDER BY pg_catalog.quote_ident(pn.nspname) || '.' || pg_catalog.quote_ident(pc.relname))
        FROM pg_catalog.pg_publication_rel pr
        JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class pc ON pc.oid = pr.prrelid
        JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace pn ON pn.oid = pc.relnamespace
        WHERE pr.prpubid = pb.oid), '[]'::jsonb))
      ORDER BY pb.pubname)
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_publication pb
  ), '[]'::jsonb),

  'unsupported', COALESCE((
    SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('kind', u.kind, 'name', u.name) ORDER BY u.kind, u.name)
    FROM unsupported u
  ), '[]'::jsonb),

  -- independent counts, straight from the catalogs, for the client's completeness check
  'counts', pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
    'relations', (SELECT count(*) FROM rel),
    'columns', (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute att JOIN rel c ON c.oid = att.attrelid
                WHERE att.attnum > 0 AND NOT att.attisdropped),
    'constraints', (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint con JOIN rel c ON c.oid = con.conrelid),
    'indexes', (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_index i JOIN rel c ON c.oid = i.indrelid),
    'triggers', (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger tg JOIN rel c ON c.oid = tg.tgrelid WHERE NOT tg.tgisinternal),
    'routines', (SELECT count(*) FROM fn WHERE prokind IN ('f', 'p')),
    'types', (SELECT count(*) FROM typ_class WHERE class IN ('enum', 'domain', 'composite')),
    'generated_types', (SELECT count(*) FROM typ_class WHERE class = 'generated'),
    'extensions', (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_extension),
    'default_acls', (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_default_acl),
    'event_triggers', (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_event_trigger),
    'publications', (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_publication),
    'unsupported', (SELECT count(*) FROM unsupported),
    -- inventory: EVERY object of these catalogs in public (extension members aside), counted without any
    -- classification — the client checks each one is reported exactly once (covered, generated or unsupported)
    'all_class', (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c WHERE c.relnamespace = (SELECT oid FROM pub)
                  AND c.oid NOT IN (SELECT oid FROM ext_cls)),
    'all_type', (SELECT count(*) FROM typ),
    'all_proc', (SELECT count(*) FROM fn),
    'all_constraint', (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint con WHERE con.connamespace = (SELECT oid FROM pub)
                       AND con.conrelid NOT IN (SELECT oid FROM ext_cls)
                       AND con.contypid NOT IN (SELECT oid FROM ext_typ)))
)

facts.routine public.requeue_failed_articles():
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.requeue_failed_articles(OUT requeued integer, OUT released integer)
 RETURNS record
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- FOR UPDATE re-checks each row's WHERE against its latest version when it takes the lock, and
  -- holds the lock until the UPDATE commits: nothing can change a selected row in between
  WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT a.id, coalesce(a.quarantine_reason = 'enrichment_failed', false) AS was_failed
    FROM public.articles a
    WHERE a.abstract IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        a.quarantine_reason = 'enrichment_failed'
        OR (coalesce(a.enrichment_attempts, 0) >= 3
            AND a.quarantine_reason IS DISTINCT FROM 'ai_refused'
            AND (a.needs_enrichment OR a.summary IS NULL OR a.clinical_bottom_line IS NULL))
      )
    FOR UPDATE
  ), upd AS (
    UPDATE public.articles a SET
      needs_enrichment  = true,
      force_retry       = true,
      quarantined       = CASE WHEN e.was_failed THEN false ELSE a.quarantined END,
      quarantine_reason = CASE WHEN e.was_failed THEN NULL  ELSE a.quarantine_reason END
    FROM eligible e
    WHERE a.id = e.id
    RETURNING e.was_failed
  )
  SELECT count(*)::integer, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE was_failed))::integer
    INTO requeued, released
    FROM upd;
END;

facts.routine public.saved_this_week(timestamp:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.saved_this_week(p_since timestamp with time zone, p_until timestamp with time zone, p_excluded uuid[], p_limit integer)
 RETURNS TABLE(article_id text, save_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT s.article_id, count(*) AS save_count
  FROM public.saved_articles s
  JOIN public.articles a ON a.id = s.article_id
  WHERE s.saved_at >= p_since
    AND s.saved_at < p_until
    AND (s.user_id IS NULL OR s.user_id <> ALL (coalesce(array_remove(p_excluded, NULL), '{}'::uuid[])))
    AND a.needs_enrichment = false
    AND a.summary IS NOT NULL
    AND a.clinical_bottom_line IS NOT NULL
    AND a.quarantined IS NOT TRUE
  GROUP BY s.article_id, a.created_at
  ORDER BY count(*) DESC, a.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, s.article_id
  LIMIT least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 20), 1), 50)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_articles_fuzzy(search_query text, similarity_threshold double precision DEFAULT 0.3)
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, title text, clinical_bottom_line text, summary text, labels text[], source_journal text, publication_date date, authors text, pubmed_id text, doi text, article_url text, strength_of_evidence text, needs_enrichment boolean, enrichment_attempts integer, quarantined boolean, created_at timestamp with time zone, similarity double precision)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT r.* FROM (
    SELECT a.id, a.title, a.clinical_bottom_line, a.summary, a.labels, a.source_journal,
      a.publication_date, a.authors, a.pubmed_id, a.doi, a.article_url,
      a.strength_of_evidence, a.needs_enrichment, a.enrichment_attempts, a.quarantined,
      a.created_at,
      GREATEST(similarity(lower(a.title), lower(search_query)),
               similarity(lower(COALESCE(a.clinical_bottom_line, '')), lower(search_query))) AS similarity
    FROM articles a
    WHERE a.needs_enrichment = false AND a.summary IS NOT NULL
      AND a.clinical_bottom_line IS NOT NULL
      AND (a.quarantined IS NULL OR a.quarantined = false)
      AND ( lower(a.title) % lower(search_query)
         OR lower(COALESCE(a.clinical_bottom_line, '')) % lower(search_query)
         OR a.title ILIKE '%' || search_query || '%'
         OR a.clinical_bottom_line ILIKE '%' || search_query || '%' )
      AND ( similarity(lower(a.title), lower(search_query)) > similarity_threshold
         OR similarity(lower(COALESCE(a.clinical_bottom_line, '')), lower(search_query)) > similarity_threshold
         OR a.title ILIKE '%' || search_query || '%'
         OR a.clinical_bottom_line ILIKE '%' || search_query || '%' )
    UNION
    SELECT a.id, a.title, a.clinical_bottom_line, a.summary, a.labels, a.source_journal,
      a.publication_date, a.authors, a.pubmed_id, a.doi, a.article_url,
      a.strength_of_evidence, a.needs_enrichment, a.enrichment_attempts, a.quarantined,
      a.created_at,
      GREATEST(similarity(lower(a.title), lower(search_query)),
               similarity(lower(COALESCE(a.clinical_bottom_line, '')), lower(search_query)))
    FROM articles a
    WHERE similarity_threshold < COALESCE(
            NULLIF(current_setting('pg_trgm.similarity_threshold', true), '')::double precision,
            show_limit())
      AND a.needs_enrichment = false AND a.summary IS NOT NULL
      AND a.clinical_bottom_line IS NOT NULL
      AND (a.quarantined IS NULL OR a.quarantined = false)
      AND ( similarity(lower(a.title), lower(search_query)) > similarity_threshold
         OR similarity(lower(COALESCE(a.clinical_bottom_line, '')), lower(search_query)) > similarity_threshold )
  ) r
  ORDER BY r.similarity DESC, r.id
  LIMIT 100;
$function$
facts.routine public.search_articles_synthesis:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_articles_synthesis(search_query text, candidate_limit integer DEFAULT 50, final_limit integer DEFAULT 15)
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, title text, clinical_bottom_line text, summary text, labels text[], source_journal text, publication_date date, authors text, pubmed_id text, doi text, article_url text, strength_of_evidence text, score double precision)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  WITH queries AS (
    SELECT
      websearch_to_tsquery('english', search_query) AS broad_q,
      phraseto_tsquery('english', search_query)     AS phrase_q
  ),
  species_context AS (
    SELECT
      CASE
        WHEN lower(search_query) ~ '\m(cat|cats|feline|kitten)\M' THEN 'feline'
        WHEN lower(search_query) ~ '\m(dog|dogs|canine|puppy|puppies)\M' THEN 'canine'
        ELSE 'any'
      END AS target_species
  ),
  -- GIN candidates only — no similarity in WHERE clause
  gin_candidates AS (
    SELECT a.id
    FROM articles a, queries q
    WHERE
      a.needs_enrichment = false
      AND a.summary IS NOT NULL
      AND a.clinical_bottom_line IS NOT NULL
      AND (a.quarantined IS NULL OR a.quarantined = false)
      AND a.search_vector @@ q.broad_q
    LIMIT candidate_limit
  ),
  -- Score candidates with species bonus
  scored AS (
    SELECT
      a.id,
      a.title,
      a.clinical_bottom_line,
      a.summary,
      a.labels,
      a.source_journal,
      a.publication_date,
      a.authors,
      a.pubmed_id,
      a.doi,
      a.article_url,
      a.strength_of_evidence,
      (
        0.50 * ts_rank_cd(a.search_vector, q.broad_q, 32) +
        0.20 * ts_rank_cd(a.search_vector, q.phrase_q, 32) +
        0.15 * CASE
                 WHEN lower(a.title) LIKE '%' || lower(search_query) || '%'
                 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0
               END +
        0.10 * CASE
                 WHEN sc.target_species = 'feline'
                      AND (a.labels && ARRAY['Feline','feline']
                           OR lower(a.title) ~ '\m(cat|cats|feline|kitten)\M')
                 THEN 1.0
                 WHEN sc.target_species = 'canine'
                      AND (a.labels && ARRAY['Canine','canine']
                           OR lower(a.title) ~ '\m(dog|dogs|canine|puppy)\M')
                 THEN 1.0
                 WHEN sc.target_species = 'any' THEN 0.5
                 ELSE 0.0
               END +
        0.05 * GREATEST(
                 similarity(lower(a.title), lower(search_query)),
                 similarity(lower(coalesce(a.clinical_bottom_line,'')), lower(search_query))
               )
      ) AS score
    FROM articles a
    JOIN gin_candidates gc ON a.id = gc.id
    CROSS JOIN queries q
    CROSS JOIN species_context sc
  )
  SELECT * FROM scored
  ORDER BY score DESC
  LIMIT final_limit;
$function$
